test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The average weight of a class of 115 students is 52.4 kg. If the average weight of the 63 boys is 60 kg, then find the average weight (in kg) of the girls in the class.

(Rounded off to one decimal place)
solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of the class = 52.4 kg

Total students in the class = 115

Average weight of boys = 60 kg

Total boys = 63

Total girls = 115 - 63 = 52

**Formula Used:**

Average weight = Total weight / Total number of students

Total weight = Average weight × Total number of students

**Calculation:**

Total weight of the class = 52.4 × 115

⇒ Total weight of the class = 6026 kg

Total weight of boys = 60 × 63

⇒ Total weight of boys = 3780 kg

Total weight of girls = Total weight of the class - Total weight of boys

⇒ Total weight of girls = 6026 - 3780

⇒ Total weight of girls = 2246 kg

Average weight of girls = Total weight of girls / Total number of girls

⇒ Average weight of girls = 2246 / 52

⇒ Average weight of girls = 43.2 kg

**The average weight of the girls in the class is 43.2 kg.**
